comments.note: FfmpegProvisionerLiveTests.cs: The test redirects both stdout and stderr (RedirectStandardOutput=true, RedirectStandardError=true) but never reads from those streams. For 'ffprobe -version' this is safe in practice — the output is tiny and will never fill an OS pipe buffer — but a future test invoking a more verbose command should use process.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync() concurrently to prevent a potential deadlock.

BuildManifest(): The osx-x64 and osx-arm64 entries reference evermeet.cx URLs. evermeet.cx packages each tool (ffmpeg, ffprobe) as separate ZIPs. The manifest entries currently point to the 'ffmpeg' URL for both binaries; a separate ffprobe URL will likely be needed (e.g. https://evermeet.cx/ffmpeg/ffprobe-7.1.zip). This is a release-gate concern, not a code defect.

LiveSettingsService.SaveAsync fires SettingsChanged. Because no handler is wired in the test this is harmless, but it is worth noting that the event is nullable-safe and the invocation pattern (_invoke(this, updated)) is correct.
